title: South Park Surprises With the Perfect JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure Shout Out – Watch
content: South Park is no stranger to fun anime shout outs and Easter Eggs, but the latest episode really went all out to show JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure some love with some very familiar poses. South Park Season 29 has made some big changes through its three episodes so far for the year.
author: ComicBook

title: Jujutsu Kaisen Hypes Jump Festa Update With New Look at Culling Game Roster Ahead of Season 4
content: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 4 is currently in the works, but fans might get an update sooner than expected. Based on a Weekly Shonen Jump manga written and illustrated by Gege Akutami, the anime adaptation by MAPPA is one of the most successful shows of all time.
author: ComicBook

title: Pandora Hearts Manga Gets 3rd Stage Musical
content: Jun Mochizuki 's Pandora Hearts manga is inspiring a third stage musical adaptation titled PandoraHearts Retrace III -Reverse corte- that will run at Theater H in Tokyo on September 17-26, 2027 and at Sankei Hall Breeze in Osaka on October 2-3, 2027. The staff streamed a trailer, but it is not available in the U.S.
author: ANN

title: Major Netflix Anime Teases Surprise Finale With New Trailer for October 2026 Return – Watch
content: A major anime series is coming back to Netflix for special new episodes later this month, and it turns out to be teasing a surprise finale with a new trailer and poster hyping up its debut.
author: ComicBook

title: 'Shingeki no Kyojin' Voice Actor Hiroshi Tsuchida Dies at 54
content: Voice actor Hiroshi Tsuchida , best known for Grisha Yeager in Shingeki no Kyojin ( Attack on Titan ) and Daikichi Kawachi in Usagi Drop ( Bunny Drop ), died on October 11 of heart failure. He was 54.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Hiroshi Tsuchida, Attack on Titan & Super Sentai Star, Dies at 54
content: Hiroshi Tsuchida, star of Ninja Sentai Kakuranger, Attack on Titan, Pokémon and more has sadly died at the age of 54 as announced by talent agency 81 Produce . The talent agency shared an official statement this morning revealing that Tsuchida had died on October 11th due to heart failure, and had a private funeral…
author: ComicBook

title: Culdcept Begins Game's Trailer Reveals PC Release on October 28
content: Neos announced on Tuesday that it will release Culdcept Begins , a new game in the Culdcept series, for PC via Steam on October 28. The company streamed a trailer: The game debuted for Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch on July 16.
author: ANN

title: 11 Years Later, Critically Acclaimed Fantasy Shares First Update on Anime Sequel
content: The beloved romance fantasy, Yona of the Dawn , written and illustrated by Kusanagi Mizuho, reached its conclusion last year after confirming an anime sequel. The information was revealed in the Hana to Yume magazine, which published the final chapter.
author: ComicBook

title: Manta Opens Platform to Independent Creators, Launches Program for Users Who Unlocked Episodes on Tapas to Rebuild Library on Platform
content: The platform, operated by RIDI , will introduce a new section dedicated to independent creators. Creators will be able to set up profiles, upload episodes through a creator studio, and publish their work directly. Readers will be able to discover new series, leave comments, and interact with creators.
author: ANN

title: Ys VIII: Lacrimosa Of Dana Game Gets Switch 2 Release on February 25
content: NIS America announced on Tuesday that Nihon Falcom's Ys VIII: Lacrimosa of DANA action role-playing game will get a Nintendo Switch 2 release on February 25, 2027. The Switch 2 version will have a framerate of up to 120 fps and will allow co-op play for two players via GameShare.
author: ANN
